analyzed_vuln.description: OFFImporter::InternReadFile trusts the face count from the OFF header (numFaces) and allocates mesh->mFaces to that size, but while parsing face lines it can stop early on malformed/truncated input without reducing mesh->mNumFaces to the number actually initialized. Later ScenePreprocessor::ProcessMesh iterates up to mesh->mNumFaces and reads face.mNumIndices from uninitialized/out-of-bounds face entries, causing a heap-buffer-overflow read at ScenePreprocessor.cpp:148.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: From the fuzzer harness, attacker-controlled bytes are parsed as OFF. The PoV provides header counts (e.g., numFaces=9) that cause allocation of 9 aiFace entries, but insufficient/invalid face records are actually parsed, so fewer faces are initialized. Because mesh->mNumFaces remains the original header value, ScenePreprocessor::ProcessScene -> ProcessMesh loops over all declared faces and reads past valid initialized data, triggering ASan heap OOB read.
